method: Six sequential alternating 32s natural-speed seeded boss trials, each at 1x and 4x CPU. Identical preserved production artifact with an instance-only number-atlas prototype. Startup is first 2s; steady excludes startup; whole-run is also retained. Screenshots follow timing. 4x is a stress proxy.
limits: Local intercepted PNG request/decode/canvas restoration is measured before gameplay at matching CPU throttle. It is not full cold-network/loading measurement. Task/script durations are elapsed CDP renderer metrics, not exclusive CPU. This is not native application integration or independent6301 judge acceptance. Fixed wall-time trials can finish at different animation states; plan/final comparisons are reported, not silently assumed.

visualReview: Four measured1024x576 fresh desktop views inspected once. All four heroes, enemy trio, HP/status marks, HUD and number/telegraph layers remain visible. Different natural animation phases are expected; these screenshots are not an exact-pixel pair. Frozen-scene160 comparisons remain the exact correctness evidence.
decision: Reject runtime adoption: steady frame pacing unchanged, startup stalls retained, no useful balanced-trial improvement despite 54987 extra bytes and separate preparation. Full cold-load/failure/font/disposal integration is not warranted without a useful benefit. No application asset or source changed; no READY.
